task: Implement kubelet serving TLS stage 3 for CIS 1.2.6 and 1.3.6, with offline verification.

events.summary: Stage 3 control-plane flags, kubeadm persistence and safe rollout and rollback. Metrics-server and acceptance rules are outside this lane.

provenance: Orchestrator measurements supplied in the Lane A brief, single-node Kubernetes v1.35.7, 2026-11-26
events.summary: Trivy reported AVD-KCV-0038 and AVD-KCV-0006. kube-bench already passed 1.3.6 and failed 1.2.6. Controller-manager help reported that the gate defaults to true. The live kubelet served a cluster-CA leaf with its IP SAN after stage 2.

The orchestrator measured both absent arguments. Repository inspection confirmed that init uses a fallback serving certificate and the post-CNI operator script enrolls the node before publishing join commands.

Pin the default controller-manager gate at init. Apply stage 3 only after each control plane validates every current kubelet endpoint against its local CA and the IP SAN. Wait for the expected Ready static Pod and persist with a kubeadm-config resourceVersion test. Restore the exact saved API server manifest when applicable and otherwise remove only the owned CA flag.
